shared_elements: low-relief carved motifs on a stone surface
a fan/radiating linear motif near the top (headdress-like in A, radiating incised lines in B)
round hollows or disc-like circular forms
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow carved motifs including a radiating, fan-like linear element in the upper zone and rounded circular forms, but these are generic shapes that any carving tradition could produce independently. A clearly depicts a single anthropomorphic figure with headdress, arms and a belt with a central disc arranged vertically over the body, whereas B shows no legible figure at all, only a faint incised design above a scattered field of round hollows, so there is no shared scene, relationship or compositional scheme.
